note: Live measurements against the production cloud execution service. A run is one authenticated task admitted over the Worker API, executed in a Cloudflare-managed Pi cell, verified by a correlated receipt, and delivered via a durable callback — no local machine in the loop.

metrics.label: End-to-end verified run
metrics.detail: Best warm admit→verified latency (authenticated task → Pi cell → Workers AI → correlated receipt).

metrics.label: Typical warm run
metrics.detail: Median warm admit→verified over live samples; tail varies with upstream model latency.

metrics.label: Concurrent fan-out
metrics.detail: Ten simultaneous runs all reached verified receipts in ~91s after the cold-start deadline grace.

metrics.label: Receipt integrity
metrics.detail: Every failure mode (cancel, deadline, bad auth, transient model, prompt-injection) fails closed. No fabricated receipt has ever passed.

invariants: Only a TERRARIUM_RESULT matching server-minted runId + taskFingerprint + nonce is success.
The execution cell holds no reusable model credential; model access is intercepted server-side.
A prompt-injection task cannot forge a receipt for another run — correlation is server-controlled.
Cold-boot time is bounded by a startup grace so it never consumes the task's execution budget.
